caption:
Your pancreas does more quiet work than almost any other organ, and it responds fast to what's on your plate. Broccoli is loaded with sulforaphane, a compound that helps calm inflammation around pancreatic cells and supports steady insulin signaling. Garlic pulls double duty here too — compounds like allicin may help ease the workload on pancreatic tissue over time. Your kidneys deserve just as much attention: red bell pepper is one of the lowest-potassium, highest-vitamin-C veggies out there, which makes it gentle on kidney function while still packing nutrition. And don't sleep on beets for your liver — they contain betaine, a compound that helps liver cells process fat instead of storing it. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
